title: Neutral threefold repetition becomes claimable at exactly the third occurrence

boundary.expect: second occurrence of the position; not yet claimable

rationale: Bare kings shuttle with no check and no attack by either side. The starting position occurs at plies 0, 4, and 8; on the third occurrence the position becomes eligible for a draw claim, and never earlier. Neither engine variant may score it as anything but a draw-valued optional end.
